modules.module_title: Conduct initial loan application assessment

pcs.pc_description: scrutinize submitted loan applications for completeness, accuracy, and eligibility based on product guidelines.
verify KYC documents such as Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, and address proof in accordance with regulatory norms.
match vehicle loan eligibility with income documentation such as salary slips, bank statements, or ITRs.
ensure the application meets criteria like age, employment type, credit history, and minimum income threshold.
flag discrepancies or missing information in the application and coordinate with the channel partner or applicant for resolution.
record application details accurately in the loan management system (LMS) or core banking platform.

modules.module_title: Evaluate creditworthiness and risk parameters

pcs.pc_description: retrieve and review credit reports from CIBIL, Experian, or other bureaus for credit score, repayment history, and defaults.
apply credit score cut-offs and internal scoring criteria for profile segmentation (prime, subprime, etc.).
analyze applicant’s repayment capacity using FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) and DTI (Debt to Income) calculations.
validate ownership and insurance documents of the vehicle, if re-financing or used vehicle loan is involved.
assess co-applicant or guarantor credentials and include in the credit evaluation process as applicable.
identify high-risk indicators like frequent job changes, address instability, or unverifiable references.
escalate cases requiring deviation approvals or policy exceptions to the appropriate credit authority.

modules.module_title: Process loan against fixed deposits

pcs.pc_description: forward completed application and appraisal report to credit officer/sanctioning authority for decisioning.
communicate sanction/rejection terms to internal teams, channel partners, and the customer.
confirm that vehicle-related documents like invoice, insurance, and RC copy are in order before disbursal.
initiate disbursal request post-verification of sanction conditions, margin payment, and documentation compliance.
ensure processing of ECS/NACH mandates or post-dated cheques (PDCs) for EMI repayments.
maintain audit trail of application documents, credit assessment, approvals, and disbursal memos for compliance.
